Review the source, destination, user, host, and timestamp fields available in the matching events.
Pivot to related events before and after the detection time.
Review the volume and destination of transferred data.
Determine whether the destination and transfer are approved.
false_positives: Legitimate administrative activity
Application or logging behavior specific to the environment
Backups, cloud synchronization, or approved bulk transfers
response: Validate the alert and document the evidence.
Escalate according to the SOC playbook if malicious activity is confirmed.
Contain the affected account or host.
Block unauthorized destinations and preserve transfer evidence.
